```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

library("fivethirtyeight")

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    .default = "other"
  ))

# count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity")
)


```

1.  **Design the Ultimate Candy.** Which ingredients show up in the winners? Compare ingredient frequency in the top 20 vs. the bottom 20, and end with your “recipe.”

## Filter top 20 and bottom 20

```{r}

top <- candy %>% 
  slice_max(winpercent, n = 20)

low <- candy %>% 
  slice_min(winpercent, n = 20)
  

  

```

```{r}

low_ans <- low %>% 
  summarise(across(c(chocolate, fruity, caramel, peanutyalmondy, nougat, crispedricewafer), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
                   ))

low_ans
```

```{r}

top_ans <- top %>% 
  summarise(across(c(chocolate, fruity, caramel, peanutyalmondy, nougat, crispedricewafer), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
                   ))

top_ans

```
